description: What a fix run came to: the change landed as a commit, a branch and a pull request, parked as wip, or the question it ended on, with the facts af measured.

issue.description: The URL of the issue the report is, or null for a text or a file.

issue_created.description: The issue that was made for a text or a file under --land pr, else null.

base.description: The branch the fix was made on and goes back to.

base_head.description: The full hash of the commit of the base when the run began.

attempts.description: How many attempts the run made; 0 for a land, which runs no brain.

rounds.description: How many rounds of a brain the run made, across its attempts.

attempts_max.description: The most attempts the run could make (--attempts); 0 for a land.

outcome.description: What the run came to: landed as a commit, parked as wip, ended on a question, failed, or a dry run that wrote nothing.

verdict.description: What af measured of the change against the baseline, or null for a run that measured nothing.

landable.description: Whether the verdict lets the change land.

closes.description: True when the revert check proved the change, so that the commit says Closes and not Refs.

baseline.description: The gate on the tree as it was, or null when it was not measured.

gate_id.description: The id of the gate run, under .agent-fox/gate/.

passed.description: Whether every check of the run passed.

after.description: The gate on the tree with the change, or null when it was not run.

gate_id.description: The id of the gate run, under .agent-fox/gate/.

passed.description: Whether every check of the run passed.

revert_check.description: The revert check, which runs on a change that may land, else null.

outcome.description: proven, not_proven, inconclusive, no_changes, no_code_changes or no_test_changes.

changed_files.description: The paths git sees changed, the protected ones that were put back left out.

reverted_paths.description: The protected paths that the change touched and af put back.

scope.description: The files the report declared against the paths that changed.

undeclared.description: Changed, and not in the report.

unchanged.description: In the report, and not changed.

land.description: Where the change was to go.

branch.description: The branch the change is on, or null when none was made.

commit.description: The full hash of the commit, or null when none was made.

pushed.description: Whether the branch is on the remote.

pull_request.description: The pull request that was opened, or null.

box.description: The box the brain worked in, or null for a run that used none.

network.description: none for a box with no network, open for one with the network of the machine, and host for a provider that puts no boundary around the tools (local and none).
